text: In November 2025 AD Ports Group sold its 9.77% stake in NMDC Group to Alpha Dhabi Holding for AED 1.6 billion; with the purchase, Alpha Dhabi's stake in NMDC Group rose to approximately 77%. AD Ports had received its stake in NMDC from Abu Dhabi's state fund ADQ ahead of NMDC's February 2022 listing.
short: Alpha Dhabi Holding owns about 77% of NMDC Group
